Gary, saw SIS debuted the AI-powered SIS Scribe at ASCA 2026 alongside the 30-year milestone.

When you put a new product in front of the whole ASC market, the regional team usually has more in-market centers than reps can cover before they ramp, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for SIS off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Gary, quick follow-up for SIS.

A launch like SIS Scribe usually expands the target list faster than headcount can keep up. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit target, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings SIS needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Gary, last bit of proof for SIS.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how SIS's reply rate likely compares to other ASC-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
